title: उत्सव Go
tagline: UtsavGo is a blockchain-powered platform leveraging NFT technology to revolutionize event ticketing, ensuring authenticity, transparency, and secure peer-to-peer exchanges.
description: UtsavGo offers a groundbreaking solution to the challenges of event ticketing by harnessing the power of blockchain and NFT (Non-Fungible Token) technology. Through this innovative platform, event tickets are minted as unique NFTs, establishing their authenticity and preventing counterfeit issues.
how_its_made: UtsavGo is an innovative event ticketing platform built on the Polygon blockchain. Utilizing IPFS, it ensures decentralized and persistent storage for ticket-related data. When an event head initiates ticket creation, each ticket is minted as a unique token on the platform. These tokens provide their holders with a special privilege, thanks to the LIT protocol: a token-gated entry where attendees can securely upload and manage necessary documents. In essence, UtsavGo offers a transparent, decentralized, and secure solution for all event ticketing needs.
